notes.title: CDF Starfighter VR Remastered Released!
notes.content:
It is here!  After 2 years work on the remastered version, and some extensive testing and further tweaking thanks to a few starfighters who have played and given feedback on the beta opt in and who have helped shaped the new game over the last few months.  A HUGE THANKS TO YOU GUYS!  YOU KNOW WHO YOU ARE!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12136735/6f90b1095775e8b8a9a19cc53d7379e914572421.jpg[/img]

[h1]MAJOR CHANGES AND IMPROVEMENTS [/h1]

[h3]Huge Performance Increase!

Control Issues fixed Up!

Crashes fixed up!

All new cockpits!

Improved User Interface and Menu system!

Shaking problems Fixed up!

Game install size halved!

Much quicker loading times!

Huge graphics and overall performance overhaul!

Improved sound and attenuation!

New content and features!

Improved AI and flight mechanics!

ZERO-G-NAVIGATION/ORIENTATION - real time heads Up display elements!

Improved Visual Effects and special; effects!

Fixed up numerous bugs and space anomalies!

Added new support for more VR headsets and motion controllers!

All HOTAS are now be compatible![/h3]




[previewyoutube=sErGg1XJOCw;full][/previewyoutube]




[h3]What has changed since the original release version in 2017 (version 1.06)?[/h3]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12136735/6148db37a05a1f90687dd67cadbc558b33d28620.jpg[/img]


[h2]MASSIVE engine change/Upgrade and fix ups![/h2]

The original game was fist developed in 4.2 and went to 4.12 (unreal engine version) in 2017 after Early Access.  The remastered version has taken the game from unreal 4.12 to 4.23 which is one of the most recent engine versions at the timing of the remastered release.  Using one of the latest version has many benefits including future support and a much better overall VR experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12136735/8cd5670e9908662fed9e098cbec57d3781518f24.jpg[/img]

[h2] Now supports Windows mixed reality headsets and motion controllers![/h2]

The original game had many limitations to hardware and controls.  The remastered version now supports more VR headsets and now supports motion controllers.  When the game was originally designed motion controllers where not available and standard.   All hotas should now be easy to set up and all game pads are now supported and can be configured to how you want to play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12136735/3814cbc661aed55462cf04c4bb4e58e22629832f.jpg[/img]

[h2]Optimisations and Better performance[/h2]

A lot of work has been done to optimise a lot of the game.  The original game was over 24gb while the remastered version is just 12gb.  Loading times are now much quicker and the game now runs much better than the original game.   The game now supports other features such as vulkan and also uses some more vr optimisation features.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12136735/9368cfa35abf6829f74ee935c804e05841ba7f7c.jpg[/img]


[h2]Improved HUD elements and cockpit displays[/h2]

All 6 player ships now have all new revamped cockpits.  The new cockpit look and feel much better and have some new features.  There is now a real time orientation and position display along with other features and improvements to all 6 unique ships.  The UI has also had a make over to make it clearer and better suited for the game.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12136735/c53463d7d2035ebbdbf8530726fe2909ddc28ca1.jpg[/img]



[h2]Major Bugs and Issues from the original have been fixed up[/h2]

A lot of the bugs and problems encountered my most have now been fixed up to make it a much more fun and enjoyable experience.  The crashes have gone allowing you to play the campaign or other modes without constant crashes and hang ups.  The shaking problem has been addressed and now plays much smoother which makes it a much more enjoyable experience.    Controls issues have been fixed up and with the inclusion of motion controller support the game is now much easier to play for everyone.  Menu`s have been improved and make aspects of the game much more accessible.  Lots of other bugs and issues have been fixed up and improved on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12136735/47cf506f53b2a5ce753a3433e492fe0a965d4282.jpg[/img]


[h2]Game play improvements and AI Balancing[/h2]

Work has been done to balance out the AI even more and make the player feel like the hero.  As well as improving on ship models etc we have made launching and landing much easier.  Rather than the old long launch tube which some found tricky to navigate, we have redesigned the launch location and made it a much quicker and easier procedure.   We have introduced some other factors to make the campaign much easier and added more content into free flight mode which now offers a huge amount of gameplay for VR explorers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12136735/b92dd97b1979a705b1ec79fea9a0b66d2880e576.jpg[/img]




I would like to thank all you guys who have supported me and CDF Starfighter VR over the years, the remastered version of the game is free for all steam owners.  You just need to do an update and play the remastered version problem free.  If you guys do encounter any bugs or have any suggestions then please feel free to report them on the bug testing forum so we can get these addressed in a future update.  Thanks again everyone, enjoy the remastered version of the game and look out for the "Rise of the Drii" campaign dlc this fall!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12136735/65391b6a684847759e40517ff34f4330d87c1d30.jpg[/img]




Don`t forget you can join us on [url=https://discord.gg/j5meeb8]discord[/url] - for the latest dev news, beta testing and more.  Our web site has been updated - [url=http://www.cdfstarfighter.com]www.cdfstarfighter.com[/url]  be sure to check it out for more info and links.

notes.title: REMASTERED VERSION - Beta-Opt In release!
notes.content:
[h2]CDF Starfighter VR "Remastered" is now available in beta Opt-In ![/h2]

The remastered version has now launched with big thanks to a few dedicated tester`s with some constructive feedback over on our discord server, we can finally unleash the beta opt-in of the re-remastered version of CDF Starfighter! with a quality upgrade and quashing the crucial bugs of the original!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12136735/503fb2295b885194b12d2566e8b2a1e2b6afaf68.jpg[/img]

The game now supports Oculus touch and VR controllers which now support VR controllers for menu and game.   Please make sure you don`t have any control problems by deleting the old game .ini file!, follow this crucial step before starting the game or you will have control problems!


[b]
You will need to delete the input.ini and engine.ini file in your " C:\Users\%UserProfile%\AppData\Local\CDFStarfighter\Saved\Config\WindowsNoEditor\" folder (it can be hidden on some windows configuration) after each update.
The way steam patch the game, these files are never changed and they should as most of the reported problems lies here. Each update is paired with a new version of these files but it is only created if the old ones are erased.
[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12136735/fd8f1a0bafb3fd0bb1381c78323f32699a07aeb7.jpg[/img]



[h1]What is new in the Remastered version?[/h1]

[b]No extreme VR shake, the new scaled game world and mechanics as well as game maps (100+) have been re-scaled to drastically reduce the shaking effect (due to the unreal engine FPU and centre of origin.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12136735/ca8d82d5fc8872d71d90297825b305ce775e0b20.png[/img]



[b]No more crashes "Predicted"  You guys can actually play though the campaign in all its glory, a lot of voice actors  and some special people helped out on this immersive and extensive VR campaign.  [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12136735/410adc91e0ed7b1d7bc806273564c1ec2353fd86.jpg[/img]

[b]All new design and cockpits with new UI, all the cockpits (in beta 1.51 the Light gunship is not remastered!)  We have had a total revamp and improvement all round to bolster the style and atmosphere of the game. The Light Gunship is last on the list and is not yet  implemented.  In the first Official Beta Opt-In please refrain from using this craft in free-flight and scramble modes![/b]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12136735/9d403e9138e406e083f4fb4dab12bfafa43f4e90.jpg[/img]


[b]Windows Mixed Reality headset support.[/b]

[b]VR Motion controller support. [/b]



There are a huge host of improvements over the original, a few more updates will be released in the coming weeks with final touches and any last remaining bugs. Our web site and store page will be going through a few changes over the coming days.  


[previewyoutube=RSWZ5IgEGn0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Hotfix 1 Released!
notes.content:
Hi Pilots, A new update is available which fixes up a few issues.  As with all updates since release v1.0 if you have not deleted a certain folder as mentioned many times, you will have numerous problems due to old redundant data from alpha/beta versions.

Update is 155 mb
-----------------------

*Fixed No controls assigned to default on first Run.
*Fixed Fatal error/crash on campaign Mission 3 ending
*Fixed Fatal error/crash on campaign Mission 4 ending
*Fixed Fatal error/crash on campaign Mission 9 ending
*Added 2 more secrets to scramble mode

We just went to full release,  please be sure you delete the said folder before leaving a bad review on the game.  Thanks pilots.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12136735/a1709c0f529b0b929254ce4e05ab8c6933092aa0.jpg[/img]


**IMPORTANT**

Everyone who has installed the game prior to this announcement must do the following : (This does NOT affect anyone who installs the game after this announcement!)

Go to your user folder in windows, make sure "show hidden files and folders" is enabled! This can be done by : 


Windows 7

1) Select the Start button, then select Control Panel > Appearance and Personalization.
2) Select Folder Options, then select the View tab.
3)Under Advanced settings, select Show hidden files, folders, and drives, and then select OK.

Windows 8 & 10

1) Navigate to the control panel. ...
2) Select Large or Small icons from the View by menu if one of them is not already selected.
3) Select File Explorer Options (sometimes called Folder options)
4) Open the View tab.

Delete the folder "CDF Starfighter" located in the Users/Appdata/Local/

Eg : C:\Users\******\AppData\Local\CDFStarfighter

This folder was created with an old build and needs to be deleted in order for the new controls and features to initialise. This folder is separate from game install and delete, so unless this folder is deleted for people with an old build, you will run into problems. please note that anyone who gets and installs the game after this announcements will not need to perform this action.

If this folder is not deleted!

New binding will not save and set.
new controls and features will not work
Frequent crashes 

On another Note,  I have designed all the CDF fleet, Pirate fleets and Krahh, Drii and other races found in this game, If you have a problem with that file an official lawsuit instead of putting more troll fodder on my games store pages saying I have stolen assets! notes.title: Update 0.97 Released!
notes.content:
